item.title: The True Value of R&D
item.description:
Image by Hermann Traub from Pixabay

Research and Development AKA R&D is a common branch in many big companies dedicated to “playing around” with ideas until they strike something good.

Experimentation is not treated as an afterthought, but as a necessity for the survival of the company.

Companies have a metric called “R &D Intensity”, the ratio of revenue spent on R&D. The riskier, or “growth oriented” the company is, the bigger the R&D intensity. Biotech is naturally a leader in the field.

item.title: Your Great Work does not matter.
item.description:
The Codex Runicus, a law code written in runes (c. 1300 CE)

“Create for the sake of creation, not for the sake of accomplishment, and you will be truly free from the shackles of normality.”

The Great Work

The Great Work is a term from Alchemy and Hermeticism, referring to a singular ultimate work of the practitioner. Their Magnum Opus. The work that defines them and drives them to discover the hidden secrets of the universe.
